summary: OT-19-S0100 consolidates the VP10 in vitro endpoints for Valquessia Pharmaceuticals SpA. The displayed Ames and micronucleus results are negative; HepG2 viability loss is cytotoxicity, not evidence of genotoxicity. Valquessia dropped the reactive side-chain branch, but its genotoxicity rationale is not supported by these tables and requires an identified source investigation record.

sheets.name: Summary

rows.v: OT-19-S0100 VP10 genotoxicity package: consolidated results

rows: GLP status is not documented in this endpoint summary. Consult the signed investigation plan and QA statement under OQ/2019/001605; no conclusion here is designated GLP.
Branch-drop decision retained; supporting genotoxicity investigation identifier is not recorded here and must be established before citing a genotoxicity rationale.

comments.text: Displayed Ames and micronucleus tables do not support the branch-drop genotoxicity rationale. Obtain the identified investigation/decision record under OQ/2019/001605; do not infer genotoxicity from viability loss.
comments.author: Lucia Moretti

sheets.name: Cytotox
rows: HepG2 viability screen (ATP content), 24 h and 48 h exposure. Cytotoxicity endpoint only; not a genotoxicity readout.

sheets.name: Ames
rows: Bacterial mutation assay with and without S9; mean revertants/plate, n=3. The archived Fold vs vehicle column has an undocumented denominator: vehicle rows are not consistently unity. Do not interpret these values as folds over concurrent strain/activation-matched vehicle. Resolve the denominator from original calculation records under OQ/2019/001605 before using folds; values are retained unchanged.
Reported bacterial outcome: {{PRJ0123:ames.outcome}}. Control-validity details remain in original investigation records; fold-normalisation discrepancy is unresolved here.

sheets.name: Micronucleus
rows: Mammalian-cell micronucleus assessment (TK6). Treatment 3 h with and without S9, recovery to 24 h. Percent micronucleated cells, RPD against vehicle.

Displayed micronucleus result is negative, with values around vehicle levels. No analogue identifiers are provided in this table, so it cannot establish repeated effects across reactive analogues. Branch-drop rationale needs an identified source record.

comments.text: Valquessia dropped the branch. These displayed negative results do not substantiate the genotoxicity rationale; identify the supporting investigation record before attributing it.
